Next, in the "interface" tab or in the "general" tab, you need to uncheck the "Enable in-game overlay for supported games" item. After that, you will be able to launch without having to use Ubisoft Connect. Make sure that the game is not running. Next, open the game folder on your computer, find the file with the .exe extension and make a shortcut to this file on your desktop. Now launch the game by clicking on the shortcut and enjoy the game without having to log in to Ubisoft Connect. However, please remember that if Ubisoft Connect is disabled, some online features of the game, such as multiplayer or achievements, may not be available. Also, disabling Ubisoft Connect may result in the inability to save some game statistics. Therefore, before disabling, it is recommended that you carefully read the possible consequences and make sure that they do not affect your gaming activity

Launch Uplay.
Open the menu in the upper-left corner and go to Settings.
In the Interface or General tab, uncheck "Enable in-game overlay for supported games".

2. Close the Game:
Ensure the game is not running before proceeding.

3. Create Shortcut to Game:
Open the game folder on your PC.
Find the game’s .exe file and create a shortcut to it on your desktop.

4. Launch the Game:
Click the shortcut to launch the game directly, bypassing Ubisoft Connect.

5. Considerations:
Disabling Ubisoft Connect may disable online features like multiplayer or achievements.

You may also lose the ability to save some game statistics or data.

Read the potential consequences to ensure they won't affect your gaming experience.

👉 Ubisoft Connect BYPASS

✅ To play Ubisoft games without using Ubisoft Connect:

1.0 Launch the Uplay app 🫷

1.1 Open the menu located in the top left corner of the screen

1.2 Go to the settings section 🫡

1.3 Then, in the "Interface" tab or in the "General" tab, uncheck the box for "Enable in-game overlay for supported games." 👌

2.0 Open the folder with the desired game on your computer 🔴

2.1 Find the file with the .exe extension and create a shortcut of this file on your desktop ✅

3.0 Now launch the game by clicking the shortcut and enjoy playing without the need to log into Ubisoft Connect 💯

WARNING: With Ubisoft Connect disabled, multiplayer, achievements, and saves may be unavailable!


text.text:
🔌 Instructions: How to play through a shared Steam account in offline mode

1. Login
• Launch Steam.
• Enter the login and password (details are in the channel).
• Be sure to check "Remember me."

2. Installation
• Download the required game if it is not yet installed.

3. Launch the game
• Start the game and wait for the main menu.
• This is necessary for Steam to save offline data.

4. Switch to offline
• Close the game.
• In the Steam client, click:
Steam → Go Offline...
• Confirm. Steam will restart in offline mode.

5. Play
• Launch the game again. Now it works without internet.

---

⚠️ Common problems and solutions

🛡 Family View
• Some accounts are protected by Family View.
• In this case, open the Steam app on PC → the library will be available.

🛠 Instead of the "Play" button, "Buy" appears

1. Enable offline mode in Steam.
2. Wait for the "Offline Mode" message to appear at the bottom.
3. Completely close Steam (stop the process via Task Manager).
4. Launch Steam again — it will open directly in offline mode.
   ✅ Now the game will become available.

🔁 Kicked out of the account immediately after login
This happens if too many people use the same account simultaneously.
To fix the problem:

1. Launch Steam in Big Picture mode (icon in the upper right corner).
2. Start downloading the game. Even if you get kicked out, the download will continue.
3. After the download finishes, enable offline mode — now no one can kick you out.

📂 Game missing from the library
It might be hidden. To find it:

1. Open the Steam app on PC.
2. In the menu, select: View → Hidden Games.
3. Find the game → right-click → Manage → Remove from hidden
